comment: ANCHOR: AGENT_DISPATCH_20261104 — P0 automatic dispatcher: deterministic tmux state classification, the operator's work order (own queued/assigned row, then a prerequisite independent review of a complete held PR including drafts, then merge-prep, then an unowned row, then a stale-claim chore), paste-buffer submission verified by a busy marker, the ledger line, the escalation threshold and the report-only merge pump. Canonical hold/check/artifact/released-custody contracts are exercised through real entrypoints. Hermetic: fake tmux/gh and temp dirs; no fleet, no network.
